# Lyrenza Vienna Ring

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Vienna Ring is in Vienna, Austria, in the Europe region.
Facilities: Indoor pool; concert concierge; cafe; ballroom. Pool or water-facility hours: 06:00-22:00.
Parking: Valet parking; EUR 42 nightly. Transportation: Ring tram stop is directly outside.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
